details:
Q1. What exact scope should this issue cover? Pick the smallest option that matches.
Choices:
A. One specific workflow, script, prompt, or doc; include its path/name in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B. One named pipeline phase end-to-end (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, or validate).
C. A cross-cutting change across multiple phases; list the exact phases/files to include.
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want in that target area?
Choices:
A. Fix incorrect, flaky, or confusing existing behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change workflow/automation behavior.
C. Improve performance, runtime, or GitHub/API/LLM cost.
D. Improve docs, logs, observability, or operator/developer UX.
Q3. What concrete evidence should define “better” for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific failing issue, PR, workflow run, or log snippet; include the identifier/link or pasted excerpt. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A before/after behavior description with the expected end state.
C. A short acceptance checklist we can validate against.
